# AeraArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/AeraArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ArkWithWithdrawalRequest](../ark-with-withdrawal-request.md)

**Title:**
AeraArk

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation through Aera/Gauntlet Alpha vaults

Implements strategy for async depositing tokens via Provisioner and managing vault units with 12h delays


## State Variables
### REQUEST_DEADLINE
Deadline for async deposit/redeem requests (24 hours)


```solidity
uint256 public constant REQUEST_DEADLINE = 24 hours
```


### MAX_PRICE_AGE
Maximum allowed price age for requests (1 hour)


```solidity
uint256 public constant MAX_PRICE_AGE = 1 hours
```


### DEFAULT_SOLVER_TIP
Default solver tip (0 for auto-price requests)


```solidity
uint256 public constant DEFAULT_SOLVER_TIP = 0
```


### DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE
Default slippage (0.02%)


```solidity
uint256 public constant DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE = 2
```


### provisioner
The Aera provisioner contract


```solidity
IProvisioner public immutable provisioner
```


### priceCalculator
The price and fee calculator contract


```solidity
IPriceAndFeeCalculator public immutable priceCalculator
```


### vault
The vault contract (multi-depositor vault)


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable vault
```


### asyncDepositRequest
The currently outstanding async deposit request (if any)


```solidity
ArkRequest public asyncDepositRequest
```


### asyncRedeemRequest
The currently outstanding async redeem request (if any)


```solidity
ArkRequest public asyncRedeemRequest
```

Returns the total assets managed by this Ark in the Aera vault


```solidity

```
**Returns**

|----|----|-----------|

### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

For Aera, this is tokens that have been processed and are sitting in the contract


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```

### _board

Requests async deposit into the Aera vault via the provisioner


### _disembark

No-op for _disembark since withdrawals are handled via request system


```solidity

```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`||
|`<none>`|`bytes`||


### _harvest

Internal function for harvesting rewards

Aera vaults auto-compound, so harvest just returns empty arrays


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    pure
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|Empty array (auto-compounding vault)|
|`rewardAmounts`|`uint256[]`|Empty array (auto-compounding vault)|

### _getRequestHashParams

Get the hash of a request from parameters


```solidity
function _getRequestHashParams(
    IERC20 token,
    address user,
    RequestType requestType,
    uint256 tokens,
    uint256 units,
    uint256 solverTip,
    uint256 deadline,
    uint256 maxPriceAge
)
    internal
    pure
    returns (bytes32);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The token that was deposited or redeemed|
|`user`|`address`|The user who made the request|
|`requestType`|`RequestType`|The type of request|
|`tokens`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens in the request|
|`units`|`uint256`|The amount of units in the request|
|`solverTip`|`uint256`|The tip paid to the solver|
|`deadline`|`uint256`|The deadline of the request|
|`maxPriceAge`|`uint256`|The maximum age of the price data|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes32`|The hash of the request|


## Errors
### InvalidAddress
Thrown when a required address is the zero address


```solidity
error InvalidAddress(string name, address addr);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`name`|`string`|The name of the offending parameter|
|`addr`|`address`|The invalid address supplied|

### AsyncDepositAlreadyExists
Thrown when boarding while an async deposit request is already outstanding


```solidity
error AsyncDepositAlreadyExists();
```

### AsyncRedeemAlreadyExists
Thrown when requesting a withdrawal while an async redeem request is already outstanding


```solidity
error AsyncRedeemAlreadyExists();
```

## Structs
### ArkRequest
Tracks an outstanding async deposit/redeem request


```solidity
struct ArkRequest {
    bytes32 hash;
    uint256 amount;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`hash`|`bytes32`|The provisioner request hash, used to check whether it is still pending|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The underlying asset amount associated with the request|
